title: Ms
incidentLocation: Emergency Department, St Thomas' Hospital, London
incidentSummary: I fell on my outstretched hand. A&E at St Thomas' X-rayed my wrist, said it was a sprain and sent me home with no follow-up. The pain continued; my GP sent me back and repeat imaging showed a scaphoid fracture. It has not healed and I now need surgery. I missed my resit exams and weeks of shifts.

events.what: Fell on outstretched hand; A&E at St Thomas' X-rayed the wrist, said sprain, no follow-up
GP referred me back; repeat imaging showed a scaphoid fracture

desiredOutcome: An explanation, an apology, and to know whether I can claim compensation
